name: Yellowstone National Park
tagline: Old Faithful area — geysers, boardwalks, and one finishable basin loop.

practical.ticket_note: Park entrance pass required; summer crowds — arrive early.
practical.transit_note: Drive to Old Faithful area; boardwalks from the visitor complex.
practical.energy_note: Boardwalks can be icy or hot steam; stay on paths.
practical.best_start: Old Faithful visitor area → boardwalk loop → one more thermal stop
practical.season_note: Winter access limited; summer is peak boardwalk season.
